_doc: B4-shape tool selection: 'create a topic endpoint' unambiguously picks create-topic-endpoint. Tool is gated (tools.yaml description requires explicit user confirmation before invoking) so the agent must NOT call on turn 1. Turn 2 'no': SEMPv2 GET on the target TE name returns 404, confirming nothing was created. Name is intentionally out-of-suite ('e2e-llm-nope-te') so a stray create is easy to spot in cleanup. Mirrors b4-select-create-vpn.
prompt: Create a new topic endpoint named e2e-llm-nope-te in VPN $BROKER_VPN on $BROKER.
